hypotheses.M0_analytic_jacobian_matches_autograd: Every analytic current-position MLP VJP has relative error at most 1e-5 against autograd.
hypotheses.M1_rank64_captures_local_task_response: Rank 64 reaches at least 0.90 median local-response cosine at every sampled block.
hypotheses.M2_rank256_nearly_completes_local_task_r: Rank 256 reaches at least 0.98 median local-response cosine at every sampled block.
hypotheses.M3_task_response_is_mode_sparse: Median task-conditioned K90 is at most 256 modes at every sampled block.
hypotheses.M4_top_subspaces_recur_across_contexts: Both input and output top-32 subspace overlap exceed three times the random expectation at every block.
hypotheses.M5_leading_singular_values_exceed_permut: The median actual leading singular value is at least 1.2 times the maximum matched null at every block.
hypotheses.M6_rank64_composes_causally: Simultaneously truncating all sampled blocks to rank 64 retains at least 0.90 median source-gradient cosine and 75 percent finite direction.
hypotheses.M7_rank16_is_not_universally_sufficient: At least one block or the simultaneous program remains below 0.90 median gradient cosine at rank 16.
